fields.title: Find the cause of a bad response
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: For each case, state where the problem is and what to do.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/0: Model names ingredients not present in the description
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/1: Responses are one sentence sometimes, a paragraph other times
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/2: Model answers a medical question instead of refusing
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/3: Model doesn't know about products added today
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — no data in context plus no permission to say 'I don't know'; instruction fix. 2 — no format specified; examples of desired response. 3 — behavior for this question class not specified; explicit rule in instruction. 4 — data not injected into context; prompt building issue, not model. In no case is model replacement the first answer.
